# Dopsy v0.1.3

This release adds prebuilt images for the Dopsy application and its restricted
Docker proxy. The two versioned images are built for Linux amd64 and arm64,
then started together in a pull-only Compose smoke test before the release is
published. The dashboard and diagnostic behavior are unchanged from v0.1.2.

## Install with published images

Download `compose.yaml`, `compose.images.yaml`, and `.env.example` from this
version, then run:

```bash
cp .env.example .env
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.images.yaml up --pull always --no-build -d
```

Open <http://localhost:8080>. Use Docker Compose 2.24.4 or newer. For a local
demo without production container data or an AI key, set
`DOPSY_DEMO_MODE=true` in `.env` before starting. See the
[installation guide](https://smn-pascal.github.io/dopsy/guide/getting-started.html)
for the exact download commands and model configuration.

The recommended setup remains bound to localhost. Dopsy v0.1 has no built-in
authentication, so do not expose it directly to the internet. The application
does not mount the Docker socket; only the restricted companion proxy does.
